_comment: Single reference for the University of Ghana undergraduate grading scale. Read by the backend smoke test (backend/src/utils/smokeTest.js) and the Flutter test (mobile/test/grading_scale_parity_test.dart) so the server's letter grades / GPA and the app's GPA cannot drift apart. The scale itself lives in backend/db/schema.sql (letter_grade), backend/src/controllers/gradeController.js (GRADE_POINTS) and mobile/lib/data/logic/academic_engine.dart (_gpa4_0Breakpoints); change all of them and this file together. Expected GPAs below were worked out by hand: sum(points x credits) / sum(credits), rounded to 2 dp. A grade of F (below 45) is the only fail.

the seeded demo student
transcripts.note: (4.0x3 + 3.0x3 + 3.5x2 + 4.0x3) / 11 = 40.0 / 11; asserted against the live API by the existing smoke check
